title: Agent workloads must declare a budget
rationale: Organization-defined agent platform governance; explicit metadata supplied by the workload owner.
recommendation: Declare and enforce BudgetLimit in the runtime platform.

title: Agent tools must use least privilege
rationale: Organization-defined agent platform governance; explicit metadata supplied by the workload owner.
recommendation: Declare and enforce LeastPrivilege in the runtime platform.

title: Production remediation must require approval
rationale: Organization-defined agent platform governance; explicit metadata supplied by the workload owner.
recommendation: Declare and enforce RemediationApprovalRequired in the runtime platform.

title: Agent execution must have an audit trail
rationale: Organization-defined agent platform governance; explicit metadata supplied by the workload owner.
recommendation: Declare and enforce AuditTrailEnabled in the runtime platform.

title: Model calls must have bounded timeouts
rationale: Organization-defined agent platform governance; explicit metadata supplied by the workload owner.
recommendation: Declare and enforce ModelTimeoutSeconds in the runtime platform.

title: Agent loops must have a maximum step count
rationale: Organization-defined agent platform governance; explicit metadata supplied by the workload owner.
recommendation: Declare and enforce MaximumSteps in the runtime platform.
